body:
New scripts/onboarding_screenshots.sh drives the real dw_gui binary under a throwaway Xvfb+xdotool setup and captures each real onboarding screen (guest menu, Claim Account modal, queue, live match, end screen) via ImageMagick import. Reuses a cached guest account across runs to stay under IDUNA's 3/day/IP signup rate limit. Committed DEADWEIGHT 7b26b52, docs/onboarding_screenshots/ + README updated.

⚓ ☃
title: Automated onboarding funnel screenshot capture (kanban #422)
